report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with low latency (62-78 ms) except one 344 ms outlier; traces show successful order, inventory, payment and postgres spans with pool size 1 and idle 1. No errors, timeouts, pool exhaustion, or memory-retention growth appear. Current evidence does not establish any bounded root cause, so hand off rather than assert one.
missing_evidence: Evidence of sustained latency or error-rate increase on /v1/checkout beyond a single 344 ms outlier
Dependency-level latency/error metrics for order, inventory, payment, redis and postgres to localize any slowdown
Connection pool saturation or wait-time metrics for postgres to test db-pool-exhaustion
Redis operation latency/timeout metrics to test redis-timeout
Memory retention time series per service to test memory-leak
Deployment or configuration change records correlated with the alert window
